meta.note: Specs and terms are transcribed from vendor official pages; fields not stated on official pages read “Check the official page”. group values: free (free tier) / trial. status values: active (free tier) / trial. cardRequired null means the official page does not state it. planKind has the same meaning as group. monitoringType values: uptime (uptime monitoring) / error-tracking (error tracking) / analytics (analytics). retentionText is the data retention period stated on the official page; unstated fields read “Check the official page”. overageBehavior is the overage behavior stated on the official page; unstated fields read “Check the official page”. paidFrom is the paid starting price stated on the official site; unstated fields read “Check the official page”.

offers.title: UptimeRobot free tier
offers.specText: $0/month; 50 monitors; 5-minute interval; HTTP/port/ping, keyword, API, UDP, DNS; only 5 integrations; basic status page; 3-month data retention; 1 status page
offers.durationText: The official pages read do not state permanent — Check the official page
offers.cardNote: Plan card wording: No credit card required!
offers.limitsText: 50 monitors; 5-minute interval; only 5 integrations; 3-month data retention; 1 status page
offers.overageBehavior: Not stated on the official pages read — Check the official page
offers.paidFrom: Solo $13/month (annual billing $12); Team $39/month (annual billing $33); Scale $83/month (annual billing $67)
risks: SSL and domain expiry monitoring: the plan card and the comparison table differ; see the notes for both wordings side by side
offers.notes: Wording differs within the same official pricing page: the Free plan card includes SSL & Domain exp. monitor; the comparison-table SSL monitoring row and Domain exp. monitoring row mark Free as not included, and the HTTPS monitoring row states SSL monitoring is included only in paid plans. Both wordings stand side by side, with no ruling.

offers.title: Sentry Developer free tier
offers.specText: $0; limited to 1 user; unlimited projects; 5 GB logs; 1 uptime monitor; 1 cron monitor; 30-day lookback; comparison table: 5k errors, 5M spans, 50 replays (period not stated)
offers.durationText: Page metadata: Start free on the Developer plan forever
offers.cardNote: Card requirements for the Developer plan are not stated on the official pages read; the Business 14-day trial needs no credit card (page metadata).
offers.limitsText: Limited to 1 user; 5k errors, 5M spans, 50 replays (comparison-table wording, period not stated); 5 GB logs; 1 uptime monitor; 1 cron monitor; 30-day lookback
offers.overageBehavior: Not stated on the official pages read — Check the official page
offers.paidFrom: Team $26/month; Business $80/month (annual billing, default prepaid data); Team includes 50K errors/month
risks: The three comparison-table figures state no period
The new-user promotional wording 5,000 free replays per month for your first 3 months is not a plan figure
offers.notes: The Errors/Spans/Replays rows in the comparison table state no period; the only per month wording on the page is the new-user promotional wording.

offers.title: Umami Hobby free tier
offers.specText: $0; 100,000 events; 3 websites; 6-month data retention; full reporting suite; data export; community support
offers.durationText: The official pages read do not state permanent — Check the official page
offers.cardNote: The pricing page states no card requirement — Check the official page.
offers.limitsText: 100,000 events; 3 websites; 6-month data retention; no team members, no API, no email reports, no session replay, no heatmap
offers.overageBehavior: Hobby overage behavior is not stated on the official pages read; paid-plan overage is billed per event, data collection is not interrupted, and no data is lost
offers.paidFrom: Pro $9/month; Business $49/month (USD, billed monthly by default); Pro overage $0.00003/event, Business overage $0.00002/event
risks: Hobby has no team members, no API, no email reports, no session replay, no heatmap
Hobby overage behavior is not stated on the official pages read
offers.notes: The Hobby Additional events cell is empty, with no per-event price; open source, self-hostable (MIT license, free to self-host).

offers.title: PostHog free tier
offers.specText: No credit card, not a trial; Analytics 1M events/month; Session replay 5K recordings/month; Feature flags 1M requests/month; Error tracking 100K exceptions/month; Surveys 1500 responses/month; Logs 10 GB ingested/month; AI Observability 100K events/month (shared with evaluations); unlimited team members; 1 project; 1-year retention; community support
offers.durationText: Free allowances reset monthly; allowances are the same with or without a card
offers.cardNote: Official wording: No credit card, not a trial.
offers.limitsText: 1 project; 1-year retention; monthly free allowances per product: see specText
offers.overageBehavior: Usage stops at the free tier limits, with no surprise billing (official wording: Usage stops at the free tier limits, so you can't be charged by surprise.)
offers.notes: Data warehouse has no separate free allowance in the free-allowance table; open source, MIT licensed.

offers.title: Plausible trial
offers.specText: 30-day free trial, no credit card required; no permanent free plan on the cloud; plans from $9/month; Starter 1 website; Growth up to 3 websites; Business up to 10 websites
offers.durationText: 30-day trial; continued use after the trial requires prepayment (terms-of-service wording)
offers.cardNote: 30-day free trial, no credit card required.
offers.limitsText: Starter 1 website; Growth up to 3 websites; Business up to 10 websites + funnels/user journeys/revenue tracking/custom properties/Stats API; annual billing saves 2 months
offers.overageBehavior: No surprise charges; exceeding the tier for two consecutive months triggers a notice asking for an upgrade
risks: No permanent free plan on the cloud
Continued use after the trial requires prepayment
offers.sourceName: Plausible official docs, terms of service, and official pages
offers.notes: Community Edition is free to self-host (AGPLv3); the tracking script is MIT.
